name: 陳盈竹
objective:
課程介紹電腦基本常識、人工智慧相關應用、程式設計簡介，內容包含資料型態、流程控制、函式、副程式、陣列與字串、檔案、應用程式設計以及類神經網路與深度學習簡介。
The course introduces basic computer concept, AI-related applications and programming technique. The contents include data types, flow control, functions, subroutine, arrays, strings, files, neural networks, deep learning and their applications.
課程進度(1-16週):
Week#1: Course overview
Week#2: Introduction to artificial intelligence and its application 
Week#3: Introduction to computer and c++ programming
Week#4: Program structure and data type
Week#5: Variables and operators
Week#6-8: Control structure
Week#9: Mid-term Exam
Week#10: Switch statement and header files
Week#11-13: Functions
Week#14: Storage class and scope
Week#15-17: Arrays
Week#18: Final exam

延伸教學與資源: ● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration) 運用生成式 AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS 等新興科技輔助教學與評量。Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.● 數位教材資源應用 (Application of Digital Resources) 採用影音多媒體或具開放授權之資源（如 OCW、開放教科書）作為主要或輔助教材。Adopts multimedia or open-licensed resources (e.g., OCW, Open Textbooks) as primary or supplementary teaching materials.
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG4：優質教育（Quality Education）SDG8：尊嚴就業與經濟發展（Decent Work and Economic Growth）SDG9：產業創新與基礎設施（Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure）
課程是否導入AI: ● 使用生成式 AI 作為教學過程的輔助工具（Use generative AI tools as an aid to the teaching process）● 使用生成式 AI 進行課堂即時互動（Use generative AI for real-time classroom interaction）● 簡單介紹 AI 的基本概念（Briefly introduce the basic concept of AI）
